tools.name: snipeit_get_me
tools.description: Get the Snipe-IT user this connection acts as: name, username, department, location and permissions. Good first call to confirm the connection. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/users/me.

tools.name: snipeit_list_hardware
tools.description: List assets (hardware), with status, model, location and assignment. Filter by model, category, location, company, status or assignee. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/hardware.

tools.name: snipeit_get_hardware
tools.description: Get one asset by its numeric id: asset tag, serial, model, status, assignment, custom fields and checkout history. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/hardware/{id}.

tools.name: snipeit_find_hardware_by_tag
tools.description: Find one asset by its asset tag, for example ASSET-0001. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/hardware/bytag/{asset_tag}.

tools.name: snipeit_find_hardware_by_serial
tools.description: Find one asset by its serial number. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/hardware/byserial/{serial}.

tools.name: snipeit_list_overdue_audits
tools.description: List assets whose physical audit is overdue. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/hardware/audit/overdue.

tools.name: snipeit_list_users
tools.description: List the users (people) in Snipe-IT, with department and location. Search by name, username, email or employee number. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/users.

tools.name: snipeit_get_user
tools.description: Get one user by numeric id, with department, location, groups and permissions. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/users/{id}.

tools.name: snipeit_list_user_assets
tools.description: List the assets currently checked out to one user. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/users/{id}/assets.

tools.name: snipeit_list_licenses
tools.description: List software licenses with seat counts and expiry. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/licenses.

tools.name: snipeit_get_license
tools.description: Get one software license by numeric id: seats, product key holder, expiry and supplier. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/licenses/{id}.

tools.name: snipeit_list_license_seats
tools.description: List the seats of one software license and who holds each seat. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/licenses/{id}/seats.

tools.name: snipeit_list_models
tools.description: List asset models (the product definitions that assets are created from). Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/models.

tools.name: snipeit_list_categories
tools.description: List categories (asset, accessory, consumable, component or license). Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/categories.

tools.name: snipeit_list_locations
tools.description: List locations (sites, buildings or rooms) with their addresses. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/locations.

tools.name: snipeit_list_status_labels
tools.description: List status labels (for example Ready to Deploy, Deployed, Broken, Archived) with their ids. Use the ids for status filters and checkouts. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/statuslabels.

tools.name: snipeit_get_activity_report
tools.description: Read the activity log: who checked out, edited or deleted what, and when. Filter by target or item. Snipe-IT API: GET /api/v1/reports/activity.

tools.name: snipeit_checkout_hardware
tools.description: Check an asset out to a user, another asset or a location. Changes who holds the asset and sets its status label. Snipe-IT API: POST /api/v1/hardware/{id}/checkout.

tools.name: snipeit_checkin_hardware
tools.description: Check an asset back in: it leaves its holder and gets the status label you give. Snipe-IT API: POST /api/v1/hardware/{id}/checkin.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: snipeit_list_users, snipeit_checkout_hardware, snipeit_checkin_hardware · Public sink: snipeit_list_users, snipeit_checkout_hardware, snipeit_checkin_hardware.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: snipeit_list_users, snipeit_checkout_hardware, snipeit_checkin_hardware · Public sink: snipeit_list_users, snipeit_checkout_hardware, snipeit_checkin_hardware

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
